brief.aim: The table is a transaction log with no plausible outcome column, so the natural task is segmenting customers into behavioral groups from aggregated purchase features; InvoiceDate is used only to compute recency relative to an observation date, so no time column is needed for partitioning.
brief.repeated_subjects: CustomerID repeats across thousands of invoice line items, so all rows of a customer must stay in one partition
brief.unit: one customer, aggregated from that customer's invoice line items (recency, frequency, monetary value, product mix)
